# data.docker_buildx_disk_usage

<!-- Code generated by tools/genskill from the provider schema. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Kind: data-source. Back to [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md).

Reads the build cache of a buildx builder, like `docker buildx du --verbose`: one entry per cache record with size, type, sharing and usage, plus the shared, private, reclaimable and total sizes printed under the table. For the daemon-wide view of images, containers and volumes use `docker_system_df`.

## Arguments and attributes

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `builder` | `string` | optional, computed |  |  | Builder whose cache is read (`--builder`). Default `default`, the daemon's built-in BuildKit (reached over the daemon's `/grpc` endpoint); other names are docker-container builders on the provider's daemon. |
| `buildx_version` | `string` | computed |  |  | The buildx release whose output format and semantics this type mirrors (pin v0.38.2); not a runtime binary, the provider never runs buildx. |
| `content_sha256` | `string` | computed |  |  | SHA-256 of disk_usage_json, to detect drift without diffing the document. |
| `disk_usage_json` | `string` | computed |  |  | Build cache records of the builder plus the totals, as one JSON document. |
| `engine_api_version` | `string` | computed |  |  | Engine API version negotiated with the daemon for this read/apply. |
| `filters` | `map(string)` | optional |  |  | Map of BuildKit cache filter keys to values (`--filter`), e.g. `{ type = "regular" }` or `{ description = "~pulled" }` (a leading `~` matches by substring). Keys: `id`, `parents`, `description`, `type`, `inuse`, `mutable`, `shared`, `private`. |
| `ids` | `list(string)` | computed |  |  | Cache record ids, largest first, e.g. for a targeted `docker_builder_prune` filter. |
| `records` | `list(object)` | computed |  |  | One entry per build cache record (all 11 `buildx du --format` placeholders). |
| `summary` | `object` | computed |  |  | Totals in bytes as printed under the table. |

## Example

```terraform
data "docker_buildx_disk_usage" "cache" {
  builder = "default"
  filters = {
    type = "regular"
  }
}

output "build_cache_bytes" {
  value = data.docker_buildx_disk_usage.cache.summary
}
```
